candidates.source_name: Ministerstvo hospodárstva SR (MHSR) – tlačové správy o investičnej pomoci

negative_findings.description: Targeted Slovak-language searches for a banking or payments shared-service/GBS centre in Žilina or Banská Bystrica returned no sector-specific hits; results were generic municipal-employment and job-portal pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Žilina Banská Bystrica centrum zdieľaných služieb banka poisťovňa nové pracovné miesta 2025' produced no relevant financial-sector centre announcements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either these cities host no significant banking/payments nearshore delivery footprint, or such presence is announced only through channels not reachable by generic search (employer career sites, local print press). Coverage for the western/central regional cities is therefore thin and should not be read as absence.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Worldline, Global Payments, Mastercard or Visa delivery/operations centre located in Košice, Nitra or Prešov.
negative_findings.result_summary: Payments-scheme and acquirer searches surfaced only global corporate and careers pages, no Slovak regional-city site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The payments half of the sector may be Bratislava-concentrated in Slovakia, with the regional nearshore footprint dominated by IT/finance captives of banks and telcos instead. Needs confirmation against company registry data rather than search.

negative_findings.description: No concrete bank–university partnership or bank-sponsored graduate programme in eastern/central Slovakia was located via search, in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: TUKE searches confirmed a Finance/Banking/Investment study programme but surfaced no named bank partnership, scholarship or trainee scheme.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The university-industry angle of the cell is currently evidenced only structurally (via Košice IT Valley membership), not by specific programmes; requires direct fetching of faculty partner pages and career-fair exhibitor lists rather than search engines.

negative_findings.description: The only banking-specific Košice expansion article surfaced (HSBC expands to Košice, The Slovak Spectator) is roughly a decade and a half old.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned the item but its vintage makes it unusable as current intelligence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search-engine ranking favours old, well-linked articles for this cell; collection must be recency-filtered and driven by feeds rather than ad-hoc search.

coverage_gaps.description: Žilina, Banská Bystrica, Nitra and Prešov are effectively uncovered — no city-specific source for financial-sector delivery centres was identified beyond national portals.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate and add the local news outlets and city/region investor pages for each city (e.g. municipal websites, regional SME/my* titles, bystricoviny-type local outlets) and the respective self-governing regions (ŽSK, BBSK, NSK, PSK); verify each individually.

coverage_gaps.description: A definitive list of banking/payments captives and BPO providers with regional Slovak sites has not been assembled; only DT IT Solutions and DT Services Europe were concretely tied to Košice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the AmCham BSCF member list and the SARIO/PwC SSC report tables, cross-reference against Finstat/ORSR company records for registered seats outside Bratislava, and build a per-employer, per-city actor map.

coverage_gaps.description: No company-registry or financial-statement source (ORSR, Finstat, registeruz) was evaluated in this pass, though these disclose employee counts and registered branch addresses by city.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Finstat and registeruz.sk as indirect sources for headcount and branch-location verification of named centres.

coverage_gaps.description: Leadership-move signal for regional centre heads (site directors, centre GMs) is only weakly covered — LinkedIn is the natural source but is ToS-blocked for automated collection.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on BSCF conference speaker lists, cluster news and regional press appointment items; consider a licensed people-data provider if leadership tracking is a priority.

coverage_gaps.description: Several URLs were inferred from search-result metadata rather than fetched in this pass (e.g. SARIO news index, EKF TUKE root, KSK site root).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass and correct any moved paths; do not treat these as confirmed reachable.

brief: Slovakia's regional banking/payments employment signal does not live in financial press: it originates with SARIO and the Ministry of Economy (investment-aid approvals naming investor, city and committed job counts), is amplified by SITA and regional newsrooms such as Korzár, and is institutionalised through AmCham's Business Service Center Forum and the Košice IT Valley cluster. Košice is by far the best-documented node — Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia is visibly building a Credit Risk and Fraud competence centre there, and the city itself publicises service-centre openings with headcount figures — while Žilina, Banská Bystrica, Nitra and Prešov produced no financial-sector-specific evidence in this pass. The highest-value quantitative instruments are employer- and city-scoped Profesia vacancy snapshots and ÚPSVaR district-level open data (including mandatory collective-redundancy reporting), which together allow announced headcount plans to be tested against realised hiring. Principal weaknesses are an incomplete per-employer/per-city actor map, unused company-registry data, and leadership-move tracking that has no legally collectable source given LinkedIn's terms.
